objectives.title: Processing Scope Specifications
objectives.description: The contract contains writings defining processing parameters.
criteria: Specification of the subject-matter of the processing.
Specification of the duration of the processing.
Specification of the nature of the processing.
Specification of the purpose(s) of the processing.
Identification of the type of personal data and categories of data subjects.
Specification of the obligations and rights of the controller.

objectives.title: Documented Instructions Compliance
objectives.description: The contract contains writings governing processor adherence to controller directives.
criteria: Obligation to process personal data solely on documented controller instructions.
Provisions governing international personal data transfers.
Notification procedures when statutory law requires processing contrary to instructions.

objectives.title: Personnel Confidentiality Commitments
objectives.description: The contract contains writings concerning authorized personnel confidentiality obligations.
criteria: Requirement for authorized personnel contractual confidentiality commitments.
Verification of statutory confidentiality duties for processing personnel.

objectives.title: Subcontractor Engagement Controls
objectives.description: The contract contains writings governing third-party processor subcontracting.
criteria: Requirement for prior written controller authorization.
Advance notification of intended sub-processor replacements.
Mechanism enabling controller objections to sub-processor modifications.
Flow-down of equivalent data protection contractual obligations.
Direct processor liability for sub-processor defaults.

objectives.title: Data Subject Requests Support
objectives.description: The contract contains writings outlining processor support for individual privacy rights.
criteria: Implementation of technical measures facilitating data subject rights fulfillment.
Implementation of organisational measures supporting controller responses to individuals.
Assistance is scoped to what is reasonably possible, taking into account the nature of the processing.

objectives.title: Post-Termination Data Disposition
objectives.description: The contract contains writings governing data status following service conclusion.
criteria: Processor obligations regarding complete personal data deletion.
Procedures governing personal data return to the controller.
Protocols for deleting existing secondary data copies.
Exception permitting retention of personal data where required by Union or Member State law.

objectives.title: Audit Verification Entitlements
objectives.description: The contract contains writings governing controller audit rights.
criteria: Mandatory provision of compliance demonstration information.
Allowance for controller-conducted audits.
Allowance for mandated third-party inspections.
Immediate notification when instructions infringe legal regulations.

objectives.title: Sufficient Guarantees Assurance
objectives.description: The contract contains writings evidencing the processor's sufficient guarantees to implement appropriate technical and organisational measures.
criteria: Processor representation of providing sufficient technical and organisational guarantees to meet regulatory requirements.
Adherence to an approved code of conduct as an element demonstrating sufficient guarantees.
Adherence to an approved certification mechanism as an element demonstrating sufficient guarantees.
